llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文直接关注增材制造Ti-6Al-4V的残余应力预测，属于L1方向的建模研究。

summary_zh.motivation: 通过热机械建模预测增材制造Ti-6Al-4V部件的残余应力。
summary_zh.method: 采用部分尺度热机械模型进行模拟。
summary_zh.result: 实现了部件尺度残余应力分布的预测。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值模拟案例进行验证。

summary_en.motivation: To predict residual stress in additively manufactured Ti-6Al-4V parts via thermomechanical modeling.
summary_en.method: A part-scale thermomechanical model was developed for the prediction.
summary_en.result: Residual stress distribution was predicted at the part scale.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed through a simulation case study.

papers.title: Effect of an inconel 625 Ni-based alloy interlayer on microstructure and mechanical properties of dissimilar rotary friction welded Ti-6Al-4V/304 stainless steel joints
papers.abstract: This study introduces an Inconel 625 interlayer to overcome the inherent incompatibility between Ti-6Al-4V titanium alloy and 304 stainless steel during rotary friction welding. The interlayer fundamentally altered the failure mechanism, shifting the fracture path from the brittle interface to the Ti-6Al-4V base metal, thereby achieving a superior strength-ductility synergy. The joint with the Inconel 625 interlayer attained an ultimate tensile strength of 726.80 MPa and a remarkable elongation of 13.25%, representing enhancements of 15.08% and 79.30%, respectively, compared to the direct joint without an interlayer. Microstructural analysis reveals that the Inconel 625 interlayer served as a diffusion barrier and reaction moderator, effectively suppressing the formation of detrimental Ti-Fe intermetallic compounds. Instead, interfacial regions were dominated by Ni-based compounds (FeNi, Ti 2 Ni, and Ni 3 Ti on the Ti-6Al-4V side; FeNi 3 and FeNi on the 304 stainless steel side). The Vickers hardness profile (304 stainless steel: 268.4 HV 1 . 0 , Inconel 625: 342 HV 1 . 0 , Ti-6Al-4V: 337.6 HV 1 . 0 ) indicates the establishment of a rational mechanical gradient, where the Inconel 625 interlayer functioned as a mechanical buffer to mitigate stress concentration. The excellent performance of the Ti-6Al-4V/Inconel 625/304 stainless steel weld joint stems from both the strengthening effect and the combined chemical–mechanical synergy enabled by the Inconel 625 interlayer, offering a viable strategy for high-performance solid-state joining of other challenging dissimilar materials.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究的是旋转摩擦焊接的异种材料连接，未涉及增材制造Ti-6Al-4V的机械性能。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not concern additively manufactured Ti-6Al-4V; it examines rotary friction welding of wrought Ti-6Al-4V to stainless steel, which is outside the AM mechanical/fatigue scope.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决Ti-6Al-4V与304不锈钢直接焊接时脆性界面问题
summary_zh.method: 引入Inconel 625中间层进行旋转摩擦焊接
summary_zh.result: 接头抗拉强度726.80 MPa，延伸率13.25%，性能显著提升
summary_zh.validation: 通过拉伸测试、显微组织和硬度分布验证

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the inherent incompatibility and brittle interface between Ti-6Al-4V and 304 stainless steel during rotary friction welding.
summary_en.method: An Inconel 625 Ni-based alloy interlayer was introduced between the two materials to act as a diffusion barrier and reaction moderator.
summary_en.result: The joint achieved an ultimate tensile strength of 726.80 MPa and elongation of 13.25%, with fracture shifting to the Ti-6Al-4V base metal.
summary_en.validation: Tensile testing, Vickers hardness profiling, and microstructural analysis (SEM/EDS) confirmed the improved mechanical and microstructural properties.
